text:
Ana - CS: Heads up — BlueHarbor asked for a focused enablement sprint: 3 half-days (AM sessions), scope = Dedicated migration + cost/perf tuning. Renewal in ~6w, account health currently yellow (some integration tickets). Need owners and a lightweight agenda.
Devon - CSM: Morning (UTC+1) preferred by customer. They want hands-on labs + an executive touchpoint on last day.
Priya - Enablement: I can own Day 1 (platform + auth + deploy flow) and Day 3 (runbooks & rollout checklist). Who picks up Day 2 (perf & cost)?
Ravi - Solutions Eng: Ill take Day 2 and cover batching, quantization, and model routing. Can add a short "troubleshooting common latency spikes" segment.
Ana - CS: Great. Can we cap each session to 3 tracked action items and a 10-min renewal signal check on Day 3? Execs want to see adoption metrics.
Priya - Enablement: Agreed. Draft agenda: 

Day A (3h half-day): intro (15m) / auth & quick deploy (35m) / lab: deploy a hello-infer app (60m) / break (10m) / Q&A + actions (40m)
Day B (3h): perf tuning deep-dive (30m) / batching & cache labs (80m) / cost analysis + guardrails (40m) / Q&A (30m)
Day C (3h): dedicated/private patterns (45m) / observability & alerts (45m) / renewal & adoption review (30m) / exec sync (20m)

Sam - SE: I can shadow Day 1 and host an office hours slot after Day B for integration follow-ups.
Scheduler Bot: Provisional presenters: Day A: Priya, Day B: Ravi, Day C: Priya + Ana.
Devon - CSM: Can we add a pre-flight health check 72h before Day A? Quick script to capture token usage, error rates, latencies. If any metric > threshold we triage pre-week.
Ravi - Solutions Eng: I'll drop a quick health-check curl in the shared lab channel. Example snippet:

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/metrics?customer=blueharbor | jq .embedding_error_rate
```

Priya - Enablement: Feedback plan: 1 short form after each day + 2 in-session polls (confidence + blockers). Will include link in pre-read.
Ana - CS: Renewal signals to capture during sessions: low usage of dedicated routes, repeated quota errors, persistent latency despite tuning. We'll log any "sales escalation" flags to the renewal tracker.
Devon - CSM: Timeline: finalize agenda by EOD Thu (1767771400), send invites Fri, pre-read 72h before Day A. Can presenters ack?
Priya - Enablement: ack :white_check_mark:
Ravi - Solutions Eng: ack :white_check_mark: I'll post health-check gist and troubleshooting runbook.
Sam - SE: ack :raised_hands: available for office hours.
Ana - CS: Thanks all. I'll update the customer record with the plan and ping execs for Day C. Let's keep this tight and capture any renewal blockers early. :rocket:
